subject: C33
required_fixes: R1 — crates/desktop-core/src/authority.rs:2226 and :2370: Scan.case is checked only for UUID shape, and settlement matches only id/prompt/response. A case-bound Runtime scan can therefore record a verdict against a non-Runtime specification with matching input. packages/desktop-contracts/src/client.ts:2024 then rejects the entire ShellSnapshot, including after the invalid result is persisted. The negative test in tests/ui_v2_workbench/main.rs uses different input for the specification and misses this defect. Refuse missing, foreign and non-Runtime case associations natively before dispatch and revalidate at settlement. Acceptance: authority tests using a specification's exact prompt/response send no case-bound scan, leave its result absent, and produce parser-valid snapshots before and after restart.

R2 — crates/desktop-core/src/transport.rs:441 and packages/desktop-contracts/src/client.ts:2036: the native call log copies HTTP header names without the renderer's 64-character limit. A response carrying an otherwise accepted 65-character header name produces a CallView that makes parseShellSnapshot reject the whole shell while Show the calls is enabled. Native status/path handling has similar unchecked differences from the parser. Normalize or consistently bound native metadata and align the wire validators; diagnostics must not invalidate unrelated product state. Acceptance: native transport-to-production-parser tests cover long valid header names and all admitted status/path limits, with valid shell observations and preserved redaction.

R3 — apps/desktop/src/v2/v2-shell.tsx:309 and v2/workbench/test-cases.tsx:80: replacing LibraryView removes case authoring, removal, import/export and explicit cross-tenant copy from the v2 destination. Only adding all bundled examples and opening/inspecting cases remain. This drops accepted C12 parity and the retained new-case contract in ui-v2/state-ownership.md; a full 32-case library cannot even free a slot. Restore the existing library workflows through the v2 presentation. Acceptance: production-client component tests and native checks create Runtime and non-Runtime cases, remove a case at the limit, import/export and explicitly copy across tenants, while specifications still dispatch no scan.

R4 — apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/test-cases.tsx:135: the screen ignores library.unsaved, problem, notice and specific failure details and offers neither saveLibraryAgain nor reopen recovery. New packs and case results remain displayed after a failed persistence write without warning that they will disappear on quit; duplicate/full pack additions also lose their actionable explanation. Restore observed operation outcomes and explicit storage recovery. Acceptance: fault-injected pack/result writes show an unsaved warning, preserve visible work, permit an explicit successful save retry, and survive restart; locked/failed loads and full/all-present additions show the corresponding reason and recovery.
